verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata has the building blocks for readiness tracking: frameworks and their requirements, controls mapped to requirements, monitoring tests, and audits. One community comment also notes users show as 'noncompliant in the Drata dashboard.' Nothing documents a per-framework readiness view that combines passing controls, open gaps and remaining work into a single percentage. missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness/progress view, a single readiness percentage, explicit breakdown of passing vs. failing controls and remaining work, independent or hands-on corroboration of readiness accuracy
